name: Popůvky (Czechia)
description: A green vertical stripe at the hoist one quarter of the flag's length, and a fly divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a black band into a white lower part and a yellow upper part.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 21 June 1999 (decision No. 21) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
